title: New Orleans Riots Shooting
description: During the 1900 New Orleans riots, multiple people were shot over several days in one of the earliest documented multiple-victim shooting incidents of the 20th century.

title: Earll Family Murders
description: A farm worker fatally shot six members of the Earll family.

title: Tuscumbia Shooting
description: A man resisting arrest opened fire on officers and civilians, killing eight people before being killed.

title: Winfield Massacre
description: Gilbert Twigg opened fire on a concert crowd before taking his own life in one of the earliest indiscriminate public mass shootings in U.S. history.

title: Asheville Shooting
description: Will Harris fired on people in downtown Asheville before being killed after a manhunt.

title: California State University, Fullerton Library Shooting
description: Edward Charles Allaway opened fire inside the university library.

title: San Ysidro McDonald's Massacre
description: Gunman James Huberty carried out one of the deadliest mass shootings in U.S. history at the time.

title: Edmond Post Office Shooting
description: Postal worker Patrick Sherrill killed coworkers before taking his own life.

title: Stockton Schoolyard Shooting
description: A gunman opened fire on children at Cleveland Elementary School.

title: Camden Shooting
description: Howard Unruh killed 13 people during one of the earliest widely documented modern mass shootings.

title: University of Texas Tower Shooting
description: Charles Whitman opened fire from the University of Texas tower.

title: Kent State Shootings
description: National Guard troops opened fire on student protesters.

title: San Rafael Civic Center Shooting
description: Gunman opened fire inside the Marin County Civic Center.

title: New Orleans Shooting
description: Mass shooting during New Year's celebrations.

title: École Polytechnique Massacre
description: A gunman attacked École Polytechnique, killing 14 women and himself.

title: Concordia University Mass Shooting
description: A professor opened fire at Concordia University, killing four colleagues before being arrested.

title: Quebec City Mosque Shooting
venue: Islamic Cultural Centre of Quebec City
description: A gunman attacked evening worshippers at the Islamic Cultural Centre of Quebec City.

title: Kauhajoki School Shooting
description: A student opened fire at a vocational college before taking his own life.

title: Cumbria Shootings
description: Taxi driver Derrick Bird carried out shootings across multiple towns in Cumbria.

title: Zug Parliament Shooting
description: A gunman attacked the Zug cantonal parliament during a legislative session.

title: Hungerford Massacre
description: Michael Ryan carried out a mass shooting across Hungerford before taking his own life.

title: Erfurt School Massacre
description: Former student opened fire inside Gutenberg Gymnasium.

title: Jokela School Shooting
description: School shooting at Jokela High School.

title: Winnenden School Shooting
description: Mass shooting at Albertville-Realschule before the attacker fled.

title: Belgrade School Shooting
description: School shooting at Vladislav Ribnikar Elementary School in Belgrade.

title: Port Arthur Massacre
description: One of Australia's deadliest mass shootings, leading to major firearm law reforms.

title: Dunblane School Massacre
description: School shooting in Dunblane, Scotland that resulted in major UK firearms legislation.

title: Utøya Mass Shooting
description: Mass shooting at a youth camp on Utøya Island following the Oslo bombing. Combined attacks killed 77 people overall.

title: Christchurch Mosque Shootings
venue: Al Noor Mosque and Linwood Islamic Centre
description: Coordinated attacks on two mosques in Christchurch.

title: Woo Bum-kon Rampage
description: A police officer carried out one of the deadliest mass shootings by a lone perpetrator in modern history.

title: 2015 Sousse Attack
description: A gunman attacked tourists at the Port El Kantaoui resort near Sousse. Thirty-eight victims were killed and 39 people were injured.

title: Paris Attacks
description: A coordinated series of terrorist attacks targeted the Bataclan concert hall, cafés and restaurants in Paris, and the area around the Stade de France.

title: Nice Truck Attack
description: A truck was deliberately driven into crowds celebrating Bastille Day along the Promenade des Anglais.

title: Brussels Bombings
description: Coordinated suicide bombings targeted Brussels Airport and the Maelbeek metro station.

title: Hanau Shootings
description: A gunman attacked two shisha bars in Hanau, killing nine victims. The perpetrator later killed his mother and himself.

title: Bogaarden Shooting
description: A gunman carried out shootings in Bogaarden and nearby Denderwindeke, killing seven people and injuring three before taking his own life.

title: Luxiol Massacre
description: A farmer carried out a shooting spree in and around Luxiol in eastern France, killing 14 people and injuring others before being captured by police.

title: Aramoana Massacre
description: A resident went on a shooting rampage in the seaside settlement of Aramoana, killing 13 people before being fatally shot by police the following day.

title: Cuers Massacre
description: A teenager carried out a shooting rampage in Cuers, killing members of his family and other people before taking his own life.

title: Reina Nightclub Shooting
description: A gunman attacked people celebrating New Year's Day at the Reina nightclub in Istanbul, killing 39 people and injuring about 70.

title: Rio de Janeiro School Shooting
description: A former student opened fire at Tasso da Silveira Municipal School in the Realengo neighborhood of Rio de Janeiro, killing 12 students and injuring 22 others.

title: Toulouse and Montauban Shootings
description: A series of shootings in Toulouse and Montauban targeted French soldiers and members of a Jewish school community. Seven victims were killed and five were wounded.

title: Kerch Polytechnic College Massacre
description: A student carried out a shooting and bombing attack at Kerch Polytechnic College, killing 20 victims and injuring 73 others before taking his own life.

title: Mladenovac and Dubona Shootings
description: A gunman opened fire in the villages of Dubona and Malo Orašje near Mladenovac, killing nine people and injuring 12.

title: Crocus City Hall Attack
description: Gunmen attacked concertgoers at Crocus City Hall near Moscow, opening fire and setting the building on fire. The attack was claimed by Islamic State.

title: Prague University Shooting
description: A gunman opened fire at the Faculty of Arts of Charles University in Prague, killing 14 victims and injuring 25 others.

title: Örebro School Shooting
description: A gunman attacked an adult education center in Örebro, killing 10 people and injuring six before taking his own life.

title: Graz School Shooting
description: A former student opened fire at a secondary school in Graz, killing 10 victims and injuring 12 others before taking his own life.

title: Nakhon Ratchasima Shootings
description: A soldier carried out a shooting rampage across several locations in and around Nakhon Ratchasima, including Terminal 21 shopping mall.

title: Nong Bua Lamphu Childcare Center Attack
description: A former police officer carried out a gun-and-knife attack beginning at a childcare center in Nong Bua Lamphu province and continuing at other locations.

title: Tsuyama Massacre
description: A mass killing in rural Tsuyama in which 30 victims were killed and three others injured before the perpetrator died by suicide.

title: Ma'alot Massacre
description: A terrorist hostage-taking at a school in Ma'alot ended with the deaths of 25 hostages and six other civilians. Most of the hostages killed were children.

title: Beslan School Siege
description: Armed militants seized School No. 1 in Beslan and held more than 1,000 people hostage for three days. The crisis ended with 334 victims killed, including 186 children.

title: 2008 Mumbai Attacks
description: A coordinated series of terrorist attacks targeted multiple locations across Mumbai, including hotels, a railway station, a café, a hospital and a Jewish community center.

title: Our Lady of Salvation Church Siege
description: Gunmen and suicide attackers seized a Catholic church during Mass in Baghdad. The hostage siege ended with 58 people killed and 78 wounded.

title: Oklahoma City Bombing
description: A truck bomb destroyed much of the Alfred P. Murrah Federal Building in Oklahoma City, killing 168 people and injuring hundreds.

title: Tokyo Subway Sarin Attack
description: Members of Aum Shinrikyo released sarin nerve agent on several Tokyo subway lines during the morning rush hour.

title: Lockerbie Bombing
description: A bomb destroyed Pan Am Flight 103 over Lockerbie, Scotland. All 259 people aboard the aircraft and 11 people on the ground were killed.

title: Air India Flight 182 Bombing
description: A bomb destroyed Air India Flight 182 over the Atlantic Ocean. All 329 people aboard were killed.

title: Enschede Fireworks Disaster
description: A massive series of explosions destroyed part of the Roombeek neighborhood after a fireworks storage facility caught fire.

title: Lod Airport Massacre
description: Three members of the Japanese Red Army attacked passengers at Lod Airport using firearms and grenades. Twenty-six victims were killed and 80 were injured.

title: Dublin and Monaghan Bombings
description: A series of coordinated car bombings in Dublin and Monaghan killed 34 people and injured approximately 300.

title: Birmingham Pub Bombings
description: Two bombs exploded in crowded public houses in central Birmingham, killing 21 people and injuring more than 180.

title: Bologna Massacre
description: A bomb exploded at Bologna Centrale railway station, killing 85 people and injuring approximately 200.

title: Hipercor Bombing
description: A car bomb exploded at the Hipercor shopping centre in Barcelona, killing 21 people and injuring 45.

title: Sharpeville Massacre
description: South African police opened fire on protesters demonstrating against apartheid-era pass laws. The commonly cited official toll was 69 killed and 180 wounded, although later research has suggested higher figures.

title: Munich Massacre
description: Members of the Black September organization took members of the Israeli Olympic delegation hostage during the Munich Games. Eleven members of the Israeli delegation were killed.

title: Cave of the Patriarchs Massacre
description: A gunman opened fire on Muslim worshippers during prayers at the Ibrahimi Mosque in Hebron, killing 29 people and wounding 125.

title: Kampala Bombings
venue: Kyadondo Rugby Club and Ethiopian Village Restaurant
description: Suicide bombings targeted crowds watching the FIFA World Cup final at two locations in Kampala.

title: 7/7 London Bombings
description: Four coordinated suicide bombings struck London's public transportation system during the morning rush hour. Fifty-two victims were killed and more than 700 people were injured.

title: Jallianwala Bagh Massacre
description: British Indian troops under Brigadier-General Reginald Dyer opened fire on a large gathering at Jallianwala Bagh. The official British Indian government inquiry recorded 379 deaths, while other historical estimates are substantially higher.

title: 16th Street Baptist Church Bombing
description: A dynamite bomb exploded at the 16th Street Baptist Church in Birmingham during the civil rights era, killing four African-American girls and injuring more than 20 people.

title: Jackson State College Shooting
description: Police opened fire during unrest at Jackson State College in Mississippi, killing two students and injuring 12 others.

title: Orangeburg Massacre
description: South Carolina Highway Patrol officers opened fire on student demonstrators at South Carolina State College during protests connected to racial segregation. Three students were killed and 27 people were wounded.

title: Kungälv School Shooting
description: A gunman opened fire during a school dance in Kungälv, killing one student and injuring six others. It is regarded as Sweden's first reported school shooting and one of Europe's early school shootings.

title: Los Angeles Times Bombing
description: A dynamite bomb destroyed much of the Los Angeles Times building and started a major fire. Twenty-one people were killed and approximately 100 were injured.

title: Wall Street Bombing
description: A bomb concealed in a horse-drawn wagon exploded during the lunch hour in New York City's Financial District. Thirty-eight people were killed and at least 143 were seriously injured.

title: No Gun Ri Massacre
description: South Korean civilian refugees were killed during several days of fighting near Nogeun-ri during the Korean War. South Korean records identified at least 163 people as dead or missing, while estimates of the total deaths have varied considerably.

title: Malampaka Massacre
description: Police constable William Unek carried out a prolonged killing spree in and around Malampaka using a rifle, an axe and other methods. Thirty-six people were ultimately killed.

title: Marikana Massacre
description: South African police opened fire on striking mineworkers at Marikana. Thirty-four mineworkers were killed and 78 were seriously injured.

title: 1975 Aki Shooting
description: A man armed with a shotgun attacked neighbors in Aki, killing six people and critically injuring two others.

title: Mitsubishi Bank Hostage Incident
description: Akiyoshi Umekawa took hostages during a bank robbery and shot four people, including two bank employees and two police officers, before being killed by police.

title: Matsumoto Sarin Gas Attack
description: Members of Aum Shinrikyo released sarin gas in a residential area of Matsumoto in an attempt to kill judges involved in a legal dispute with the group.

title: Kobe Shooting
description: A Chinese man carried out a revenge shooting in Kobe following the 1928 Jinan incident. Historical sources differ on the exact number killed, with estimates ranging from seven to eleven victims.

title: Shinwa Village Familicide
description: A man armed with a shotgun killed members of his family and set the house on fire. Eight people died and one person was wounded.

title: Luxor Massacre
description: Gunmen attacked tourists at the archaeological site of Deir el-Bahri near Luxor. Sixty-two people were killed, most of them foreign tourists.

title: Garissa University College Attack
description: Al-Shabaab gunmen attacked Garissa University College and took students hostage. The attack killed 148 people, including 142 students, and injured at least 79 others.

title: Suzano School Shooting
description: Two former students attacked Professor Raul Brasil State School in Suzano. Seven victims at the school were killed and 11 people were injured; the two attackers also died.

title: Luby's Cafeteria Shooting
description: Mass shooting at a Luby's Cafeteria in Killeen, Texas.

title: Monash University Shooting
description: Shooting at Monash University in Melbourne, Australia, resulting in two deaths and five injuries.

title: Fort Hood Shooting
venue: Fort Hood Soldier Readiness Processing Center
description: Mass shooting at the Soldier Readiness Processing Center at Fort Hood.

title: Oslo Government Quarter Bombing
description: Car bombing in Oslo's Government Quarter. The bombing was followed later that day by the separate Utøya shooting.

title: El Paso Walmart Shooting
description: Mass shooting at a Walmart in El Paso, Texas, that killed 23 people and injured 22 others.

title: Marjory Stoneman Douglas High School Shooting
description: A former student opened fire at Marjory Stoneman Douglas High School in Parkland, Florida, killing 17 people and injuring 17 others.

title: Tree of Life Synagogue Shooting
description: A gunman opened fire inside the Tree of Life synagogue complex in Pittsburgh, killing 11 people and wounding six others, including law enforcement officers.

title: Christchurch Mosque Attacks
venue: Masjid an-Nur and Linwood Islamic Centre
description: A terrorist attacked worshippers at two mosques in Christchurch, killing 51 people and causing gunshot injuries to 40 others.

title: Dayton Shooting
description: A gunman opened fire in Dayton's Oregon District, killing nine people and injuring 27 others.

title: Robb Elementary School Shooting
description: A mass shooting at Robb Elementary School in Uvalde, Texas, killed 19 students and two teachers and physically injured at least 17 others.

title: Aurora Theater Shooting
description: Mass shooting at the Century 16 movie theater in Aurora, Colorado. Twelve people were killed and 58 were wounded by gunfire.

title: Sutherland Springs Church Shooting
description: Mass shooting at First Baptist Church in Sutherland Springs, Texas. Authorities reported 26 fatalities, a figure that includes an unborn child; 25 people were physically killed and 20 others were injured.

title: Virginia Beach Municipal Center Shooting
description: A city employee opened fire inside Building 2 of the Virginia Beach Municipal Center, killing 12 people and wounding five others.

title: Halle Synagogue Shooting
description: Antisemitic terrorist attack in Halle, Germany, during Yom Kippur. The attacker attempted to enter a synagogue and subsequently killed two people and injured two others.

title: Hanau Shootings
description: Racist terrorist attack targeting people at several locations in Hanau, Germany. Nine people were killed and six others were injured.

title: Westroads Mall Shooting
description: A gunman opened fire inside the Von Maur department store at Westroads Mall in Omaha, killing eight victims and injuring five others before taking his own life.

title: Oak Creek Sikh Temple Shooting
description: A gunman attacked worshippers at the Sikh Temple of Wisconsin in Oak Creek, killing six victims and wounding four others.

title: Isla Vista Killings
description: A series of attacks in Isla Vista, California, involving stabbing, shooting and vehicle attacks. Six victims were killed and 14 people were injured; the attacker also died.

title: Atlanta Spa Shootings
description: A series of shootings at three spas and massage businesses in the Atlanta metropolitan area killed eight people and wounded one other person.

title: Highland Park Parade Shooting
description: A gunman opened fire from a rooftop on people attending a Fourth of July parade in Highland Park, Illinois, killing seven people and injuring 48 others.

title: Red Lake High School Shooting
venue: Red Lake Senior High School and Residence
description: A shooting at Red Lake Senior High School and a nearby residence killed nine victims, including a security guard, teacher, students and family members, and wounded six students. The perpetrator later died by suicide.

title: Binghamton American Civic Association Shooting
description: A gunman opened fire at the American Civic Association in Binghamton, New York, killing 13 people and wounding four others before dying by suicide.

title: Fort Lauderdale-Hollywood International Airport Shooting
description: A gunman opened fire in the baggage claim area of Terminal 2 at Fort Lauderdale-Hollywood International Airport, killing five people and wounding six others.

title: Santa Fe High School Shooting
description: A student opened fire at Santa Fe High School in Texas, killing eight students and two teachers and injuring 13 others.

title: 2016 Munich Shooting
venue: Olympia Shopping Center and surrounding locations
description: A gunman opened fire near the Olympia shopping center and at nearby locations in Munich, killing nine victims and injuring 36 people before dying by suicide.

title: Chardon High School Shooting
description: A student opened fire in the cafeteria at Chardon High School in Chardon, Ohio. Three people were killed and three were wounded.

title: Oikos University Shooting
description: A gunman opened fire inside Oikos University in Oakland, California. Seven people were killed and three were wounded.

title: Santa Monica College Shooting
description: A gunman killed his father and brother at a Santa Monica residence before traveling to Santa Monica College, where he continued shooting. Five victims were killed and four were wounded.

title: Fort Hood Shooting
description: A soldier opened fire at multiple locations on the Fort Hood Army Base in Texas. Three soldiers were killed and 12 were wounded. The shooter died by suicide after being confronted by military law enforcement.

title: Marysville-Pilchuck High School Shooting
description: A student opened fire in the cafeteria of Marysville-Pilchuck High School in Marysville, Washington. Four students were killed and three were wounded.

title: Marshall County High School Shooting
description: A student opened fire at Marshall County High School in Benton, Kentucky. Two students were killed and 21 students were wounded.

title: City Grill Cafe Shooting
description: A gunman opened fire inside the City Grill Cafe in Hurtsboro, Alabama, killing two people and wounding two others.

title: YouTube Headquarters Shooting
description: A shooter opened fire outside YouTube headquarters in San Bruno, California. Four people were wounded and the shooter died by suicide at the scene.

title: Waffle House Shooting
description: A gunman opened fire at a Waffle House restaurant in Nashville, Tennessee. Four people were killed and four others were wounded.

title: Capital Gazette Shooting
description: A gunman entered the Capital Gazette newspaper offices in Annapolis, Maryland, and opened fire, killing five people and wounding two others.

title: Ben E. Keith Gulf Coast Shooting
venue: Ben E. Keith Gulf Coast Food and Beverage Distributor
description: An off-duty employee opened fire at coworkers at the Ben E. Keith Gulf Coast food and beverage distributor in Missouri City, Texas. One person was killed and one was wounded.

title: GLHF Game Bar Shooting
venue: GLHF Game Bar at Chicago Pizza and Sports Grill
description: A gunman opened fire during a video game tournament at the GLHF Game Bar in Jacksonville, Florida. Two people were killed and 11 were wounded.

title: Fifth Third Center Shooting
description: A gunman opened fire in the lobby of the Fifth Third Center in Cincinnati, Ohio. Three people were killed and two were wounded before the shooter was killed by law enforcement.

title: T&T Trucking and Residence Shootings
description: A gunman attacked people at T&T Trucking and a nearby residence in Bakersfield, California. Five people were killed and no additional people were wounded.

title: WTS Paradigm Shooting
description: A gunman opened fire at coworkers inside WTS Paradigm, a software company in Middleton, Wisconsin. Four people were wounded and no one was killed.

title: SunTrust Bank Shooting
description: A gunman opened fire inside a SunTrust Bank in Sebring, Florida, killing five people. No other victims were wounded.

title: Henry Pratt Company Warehouse Shooting
description: A former employee opened fire during a termination meeting at the Henry Pratt Company warehouse in Aurora, Illinois. Five employees were killed and six people were wounded, including five law enforcement officers.

title: Naval Air Station Pensacola Shooting
description: A gunman opened fire inside a training classroom at Naval Air Station Pensacola, killing three U.S. service members and wounding eight others. The FBI and Department of Justice later classified the attack as an act of terrorism.

title: Chabad of Poway Synagogue Shooting
description: A gunman opened fire inside the Chabad of Poway Synagogue in Poway, California. One person was killed and three others were wounded.

title: University of North Carolina at Charlotte Shooting
description: A former student opened fire inside a classroom building at the University of North Carolina at Charlotte. Two students were killed and four were wounded. A student helped restrain the shooter until campus police arrived.

title: 9ine Ultra Lounge Shooting
description: A gunman opened fire outside the 9ine Ultra Lounge in Kansas City, Missouri, after an altercation with patrons. One person was killed and 16 people were wounded.

title: NYPD 41st Precinct Office Shooting
description: A gunman first fired at a marked NYPD vehicle and later opened fire inside the NYPD 41st Precinct office in the Bronx. Two law enforcement officers were wounded.

title: Portstewart Senior Apartments Shooting
description: A gunman opened fire inside the Portstewart Senior Apartments in Caldwell, Idaho. One person was killed and three people were wounded.

title: Molson Coors Building Shooting
description: A gunman opened fire inside the Molson Coors building in Milwaukee, Wisconsin, killing five employees before dying by suicide at the scene.

title: Kum & Go Gas Station Shooting
description: A gunman opened fire at a Kum & Go gas station in Springfield, Missouri. Four people were killed, including a law enforcement officer and an employee, and two people were wounded, including another officer.
